hint.en: How many →s are in the goal?

hint.zh: 最里面的框里，两个条件都看得见。
hint.en: Inside the innermost box, both conditions are visible.

t.zh: 「周六的话，下雨我就休息」和「下雨的话，周六我就休息」说的是一回事，可证明核只认证出来的东西。
t.en: “On a Saturday, if it rains I rest” and “if it rains, on a Saturday I rest” say the same thing, but the kernel only accepts what is proved.
